48:    """Helper function to escape telegram markup symbols.
49:
50:    .. versionchanged:: 20.3
51:        Custom emoji entity escaping is now supported.
52:
53:    Args:
54:        text (:obj:`str`): The text.
55:        version (:obj:`int` | :obj:`str`): Use to specify the version of telegrams Markdown.
56:            Either ``1`` or ``2``. Defaults to ``1``.
57:        entity_type (:obj:`str`, optional): For the entity types
58:            :tg-const:`telegram.MessageEntity.PRE`, :tg-const:`telegram.MessageEntity.CODE` and
59:            the link part of :tg-const:`telegram.MessageEntity.TEXT_LINK` and
60:            :tg-const:`telegram.MessageEntity.CUSTOM_EMOJI`, only certain characters need to be
61:            escaped in :tg-const:`telegram.constants.ParseMode.MARKDOWN_V2`. See the `official API
62:            documentation <https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options>`_ for details.
63:            Only valid in combination with ``version=2``, will be ignored else.
64:    """
65:    if int(version) == 1:
66:        escape_chars = r"_*`["
67:    elif int(version) == 2:
68:        if entity_type in ["pre", "code"]:
69:            escape_chars = r"\`"
70:        elif entity_type in ["text_link", "custom_emoji"]:
71:            escape_chars = r"\)"
72:        else:
73:            escape_chars = r"\_*[]()~`>#+-=|{}.!"
74:    else:
75:        raise ValueError("Markdown version must be either 1 or 2!")
76:
77:    return re.sub(f"([{re.escape(escape_chars)}])", r"\\\1", text)
